map.龋病风险Cariogram评分器 - 综合龋病经历、饮食、菌斑、细菌、唾液等因素: Caries Risk Cariogram Scorer - Integrates caries experience, diet, plaque, bacteria, saliva and other factors to assess new-caries risk. A professional medical tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
map.Cariogram 龋病风险：总分 = Σ(各因素 0~3 分 × 权重)，权重: Cariogram caries risk: total score = Σ(each factor 0~3 points × weight), with weights caries experience 0.18, systemic disease 0.06, diet content 0.10, diet frequency 0.14, plaque amount 0.10, mutans streptococci 0.14, fluoride exposure 0.10, saliva secretion 0.09, saliva buffering 0.09; risk score = round(total score ÷ 3 × 100), chance of avoiding new caries = 100 − risk score. Grading: risk score < 25 low risk (recall in 6~12 months), < 50 moderate (3~6 months), < 75 high (3 months), ≥ 75 very high (2~3 months); the main risk factors are the top 3 factors scoring ≥ 2.
